# N3-B1 — inactive application mutation compatibility verification

Implemented the first evidence-and-adapter gate only. STOP FOR USER REVIEW. No B2, N3-C/N4, production routing, migration, installation or Obsidian reload/restart.

Exactly 25 approved new outputs were added. No existing source was edited. The explicitly imported application sibling exposes capabilities/mutate/dispose, closed backend/authority-scoped intents, single-command translation and coherent read-after-write. It opens no root, allocates no identities, owns no mutation queue and exposes no unrestricted executor. Production remains the Legacy Task Service.

Recurrence uses unchanged supplied B1/B2 contracts. Full Save, rich creation, clear-completed/source-position/promotion/cross-owner operations reject before dispatch. The complete stable intent digest/version/reason is bound through the existing N3-A writer reason and normal receipt coordination. Identical supported retries retain original effects; changed stable evidence conflicts. Unsupported local actions explicitly leave prior outcomes not checked. Known native commitment stays committed when refresh fails. Uncertainty retains the original pending operation ID, with a different blocked request identified separately. No absent receipt or restart authorizes replacement IDs or successors.

Read-after-write verifies a scoped same-authority capture and exact receipt cut, separates later current state from the original receipt, and rejects stale/disposed/mismatched captures. Allowlisted projections exclude private carriers, raw receipts, continuation and Step bodies. Navigation needs no invented note. N2 still cannot load rich editor or recurrence-definition drafts. Capability observations do not guarantee admission or draft validity.

Its outer inventory authenticates the ZIP and internal per-file SHA256 inventory. The authorization/reviewed-contract text is explicitly a transcription, not a verbatim chat export.

Claims cover tested cooperative local execution, coherent observations and process interruption. They exclude power loss/cloud rollback, hostile writers, distributed uniqueness, complete-directory rollback, durable invalidation, atomic identity-plan consumption and atomic task/Oath/application persistence. Ordinary/restored Oath ordering and unsaved-latch durability remain unresolved. No real Oath/Strict enforcement or production application startup was launched.
